note: Raw archives are not stored in the source tree. Retrieve each file from its source into one directory at the listed relative path, then run 'prepare_event.py check --raw DIR'. Horizons responses embed their generation time, so a fresh download has a different SHA-256; compare the parsed records instead (prepare_event.py derive prints them into derived.json).

ccmc/goes-13.json.source: CCMC SEP scoreboard 2020 campaign, event 20130411 (https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/assessment/topics/SEP/campaign2020/20130411.php), GOES-13 OpSEP measurement JSON
